comparison.objective: Candidate extracts one locked terminal; record seats an add-on board onto two header rows.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses wire deflection, recessed single-blade tab release, and coordinated withdrawal; record uses square multi-pin alignment and even pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective terminal removal without crimp, housing, or neighbor damage; record requires fully seated, released board with no pin bending.
comparison.reason: Extraction through a recessed latch tests different contact mechanics from simultaneous multi-pin board insertion.
